prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph from a first-floor window height, 50mm lens, looking down at a terraced street in cool blue evening light, slightly hazy. Pebbledash and red-brick front walls, slate roofs, chimney pots, a lamp post just switched on. Four front gardens carry election signs in party colours with plain text: "Vote Green", "Labour", "Vote Conservative", "Liberal Democrats". A middle-aged neighbour in a dressing gown and slippers drags a black wheelie bin along the pavement, small in the frame, face turned away. Candid, slightly underexposed, natural noise, modest depth of field, like a phone snapshot by a resident. Thanks.
